create_MPSDWAI_dataset: create an MPSDWAI dataset instance with a specified split, root directory, and resolution for metric-scale outdoor scenes
load_MPSD_scenes: load MPSD scene metadata from a numpy split file and populate the scene list for training or validation
sample_MPSD_views: sample N covisible views from an MPSD scene using pairwise covisibility and return image, depth, and camera data
run_MPSD_viz: run the MPSD dataset CLI with rerun visualization to log camera poses, RGB images, depth maps, and point clouds
review_MPSDWAI_class: review the MPSDWAI class to understand how it loads WAI format data, applies non-ambiguous masks, and resizes views
